checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Output contains the full original 10-second kitchen-table video, unchanged
must.why: Only a 60 s audio file was delivered. There is no video in the output.

must.item: Music is audible and warm, hopeful, gentle
must.why: The track has sound at a peak of -1 dB. Its mood cannot be judged without hearing it.

must.item: Woman's original speech remains audible and understandable throughout
must.why: The output has no video and no speech, so the voice is not part of the deliverable.

must.item: Music ends with the video rather than running over extra footage or a blank screen
must.why: The track runs 60 s against a 10 s clip and is not attached to any video.

faults.what: Output is only a 60 s WAV music track, not a video. The music was never mixed with the user's clip, which was the core request.
The track is 60 s, but the video is 10 s. The length was not matched, and 60 credits were spent when the 15 s minimum would have cost far fewer.

summary: The agent delivered only a standalone 60-second music track, not the clip with music under the speech, and the track is six times longer than the 10-second video.
